actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.typefully_create_draft.descripti: Create cross-platform, single-post drafts with text and optional media URLs. For threads (multiple posts) or advanced control, use "Create Draft Advanced" instead.
actions.typefully_create_draft.props.dra: An optional title for the draft (visible only in Typefully).
actions.typefully_create_draft.props.pla: Which platforms to publish to. At least one platform must be selected.
actions.typefully_create_draft.props.pub: Schedule the draft for a specific date/time. Leave empty to save as draft.
actions.typefully_create_draft.props.rep: URL of an X post to reply to.
actions.typefully_create_draft.props.sha: Generate a share URL for the draft.
actions.typefully_create_draft.props.tag: Tags to apply to the draft.
actions.typefully_create_draft.props.tex: The text content of the post.
Create multi-post threads with full control. Supports threads (multiple posts), different content and media per post with pre-uploaded media IDs using JSON format. For single posts with simple text and media URLs, use "Create Draft Simple" instead.
An optional title for the draft.

A JSON object defining per-platform content. Each key is a platform name (x, linkedin, threads, bluesky, mastodon) with an object containing "enabled" (boolean) and "posts" (array of {text} objects). For threads/X, add multiple posts. X also supports "settings": {"reply_to_url": "..."}. Example: {"x": {"enabled": true, "posts": [{"text": "Tweet 1"}, {"text": "Tweet 2"}]}, "linkedin": {"enabled": true, "posts": [{"text": "LinkedIn post"}]}}
Schedule the draft for a specific date/time. Leave empty to save as draft.
Generate a share URL for the draft.
Tags to apply to the draft.
actions.typefully_delete_draft.props.dra: The ID of the draft to delete.
actions.typefully_get_draft.description: Retrieve a specific draft by its ID.
actions.typefully_get_draft.props.draft_: The ID of the draft to retrieve.
actions.typefully_list_drafts.props.limi: Maximum number of drafts to return (1-50).
actions.typefully_publish_draft_now.desc: Immediately publishes an existing draft to all configured platforms.
actions.typefully_publish_draft_now.prop: The ID of the draft to publish.
actions.typefully_schedule_draft.descrip: Schedules an existing draft to be published at a specific time.
actions.typefully_schedule_draft.props.d: The ID of the draft to schedule.
actions.typefully_schedule_draft.props.s: The date and time to publish the draft (ISO 8601 format with timezone).
actions.typefully_upload_media.descripti: Uploads a media file (image, video, GIF, or PDF) to Typefully. Returns a media ID that can be used when creating drafts.
actions.typefully_upload_media.props.fil: The media file to upload (image, video, GIF, or PDF).

triggers.typefully_new_event.description: Triggers when a webhook event is received from Typefully.
triggers.typefully_new_event.props.event: Filter which events trigger this flow. Leave empty to receive all events configured in Typefully.
triggers.typefully_new_event.props.instr:
1. In Typefully, go to **Settings → API**.
2. Go to the **Webhooks** section and click **Add webhook**.
3. Paste the following URL into the webhook endpoint field:
```text
{{webhookUrl}}
```
4. Select the events you want to receive and click **Save**.
